function.description: Read authenticated Lighter account trade history using short-lived read-only authorization derived locally from the saved Core or Robinhood Chain trading credential. Use when the user asks for their fills, personal account trades, or executed trades rather than public market tape. Defaults to the saved credential's account when accountIndex is omitted and refuses account mismatches. Returns exact provider string trade and order ids. Read-only: no signing, order placement, cancellation, deposit, or withdrawal support.
function.name: lighter__trades_list

accountIndex.description: Optional account index. Omit to use the account bound to the default saved Vex-managed Lighter trading credential. Derived read-only authorization refuses account mismatches.

environment.description: Optional public Lighter environment to read: core for Lighter Core, rhc for Robinhood Chain. Defaults to rhc for conversational Lighter requests. Any other value is rejected.

limit.description: Max account order/trade rows to return (default 25, max 50). Out-of-range values are rejected.
